==English==

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|null|-ify|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈnʌlɪfaɪ/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-nullify.ogg|a=US}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive|legal}} To make legally [[invalid]].
#: {{nearsyn|en|cancel|void#Verb|quash}}
#: {{ux|en|The contract has been '''nullified'''.}}
# To [[prevent]] from happening.
# To make of no use or value; to [[cancel out]].
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=1966|journal=Popular Mechanics|volume=125|issue=2|page=115
|passage=Blowproof water has given the Navy the weapon it needed to fight fires with helicopters. Previously, the downwash from the rotor blades blew the foam, or whatever agent was being used, off the fire, '''nullifying''' its effect.}}

====Synonyms====
* {{s|to make legally invalid}} {{l|en|annul}}, {{l|en|cancel}}

|null
|null and void
|nullifiable
|nullification
}}
